facts.fact: Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO officially launched the PI-SPI interoperable instant payment platform on 30 September 2025, with 80 institutions already connected and connection mandatory for all UEMOA financial institutions from 30 June 2026.
Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO's PI-SPI instant payment platform covers banks, microfinance, e-money and payment institutions across the UEMOA, Cote d'Ivoire's union.

CIV.note: No consumer-protection rule or complaints body stated.

facts.fact: Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO launched the regional PI-SPI instant payment platform on 30 September 2025 for all UEMOA institutions, with 80 connected.

CIV.note: No government payment to people stated.
Only a 2022 UEMOA-wide figure from an economist, no named survey.

facts.fact: Fraternite Matin, citing GSMA, says the UEMOA had over 130 million mobile money accounts in 2024, nearly 40% active, and telecoms handle over 80% of electronic transactions.

Fraternite Matin reports PI-SPI, launched by the BCEAO on 30 September 2025, lets users transfer instantly between bank accounts, mobile money wallets and microfinance accounts, with 80 institutions connected.

CIV.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
